2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/78). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #78): "(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)\nI, II — Heavenly Strike — Tap target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)\nIII — Diamond Dust — Draw a card for each tapped creature your opponents control." ({3}{U}{U}, Enchantment Creature — Saga Elemental, 4/5).

The old chapterIII 'genuine gap' note (Card.isTapped() not exposed) was STALE — ENGINE_GAPS.md confirms Card.isTapped() genuinely exists (interfaces.ts, mirroring RealCard.tapped) and summon-primal-garuda's own definition.ts had already corrected the same stale claim on an unrelated card/effect. Both real engine primitives this migration needed were already CLOSED per ENGINE_GAPS.md before starting: Saga lore-counter automation (saga.ts, `advanceSaga`/`advanceSagasAfterDrawStep`) and real stun counters (state.ts's own `untap` chokepoint, Ice Flan/Tonberry precedent) — reused directly, no new engine work.

definition.ts rewritten: chapters I/II now use real `tapTarget`+`putCounterTarget` (validType:'creature', owner:'opponents', counterType:'stun') instead of the old `custom` no-op-adjacent workaround — exact same two-effect shape Ice Flan's own onEnter trigger already establishes for the identical real text ('Tap target X. Put a stun counter on it.'), reused verbatim since `chooseTarget`'s deterministic pool-candidate rule lands both effects on the same chosen creature (no shared-target field needed). Chapter III now a real `{kind:'drawCard', amount: (ctx) => ctx.opponents.flatMap(p => p.getCreaturesInPlay()).filter(c => c.isTapped()).length}` — a genuine live `Computed<number>` read, not a no-op or a fixed constant (Summon: Bahamut's own chapter III is a fixed 2; this is the first FIN Saga chapter in the pool with a board-counted variable draw).

Scenarios.ts rewritten as a real engine-piloted trace (engine-trace.ts), same house style summon-bahamut's own plain (non-transforming) Saga scenario establishes. One real subtlety worth recording: a Saga's own real timing (chapter I -> III is two of the OPPONENT's own untap steps; chapter II -> III is only one) means a stun counter applied at chapter I is normally gone AND the creature genuinely re-untapped by chapter III (a stun counter only delays exactly one untap) — so demonstrating a real, non-trivial count of 2 tapped creatures at chapter III (rather than a trivial, always-1 result) needed a second, independent real tap: the scenario has the opponent's own Coeurl (chapter I's target) shed its stun counter, actually untap, then get ATTACKED WITH during the opponent's own following combat (a real, unrelated tap, independent of this card's own stun mechanic) — while Hill Gigas (chapter II's target, stunned only one untap step before III) is still held tapped by its own counter. Both genuinely tapped when chapter III fires: real trace shows two `read:isTapped` lines (both true) followed by two real `drawCard` lines, not a hardcoded amount. `pilotDeclareAttackers`/`pilotDeclareBlockers`/`pilotResolveCombatDamage`/`advanceToDeclareAttackersStep` (already-built engine-trace.ts helpers, same ones adelbert-steiner/diamond-weapon use) piloted the opponent's own attack; `advanceToPlayersNextMain1(pilot, pilot.opponents[0]!)` (diamond-weapon's own precedent) advanced to the OPPONENT's next Main1/combat, not 'yours'.

10 source + 2 sink facts, real-annotated via a new annotations-authoring.json + compute-annotations.mjs (card added to scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs's ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS). Source facts, in oracle order: (1) self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Creature' (same Bahamut-precedent offsets — identical 'Enchantment Creature —' prefix). (2) self-enters {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Enchantment Creature'. (3)+(4) chapter I's real tap+stun (SOURCE) {event:'tap', controller:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} and {event:'putCounter', counterType:'stun', controller:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} — Ice Flan's own exact vocabulary reused (this card's own real text has no artifact option, so `has` not `hasAny`). (5)+(6) chapter II's identical pair, repeated per real occurrence (same convention Jill's own chapter I/II Mesmerize facts and Dion's own chapter I/II facts already establish for a twice-fired identical ability). (7) chapter III's real scaling drawCard {event:'drawCard', controller:'you'} — value hand-corrected to 4 after discovering compute-weights.mjs's `sourceMagnitude` has NO case for `event:'drawCard'` at all (a real, pre-existing gap — grepped the script, confirmed no 'drawCard' branch exists anywhere in it; this silently affects Summon: Bahamut's own already-migrated chapter III fact too, which would ALSO regress from 4 to 1 if that card were ever rerun through compute-weights.mjs unscoped or via --slug, since it's in the exact same unhandled-event bucket — not something this task fixed, since a correct fix needs to distinguish a chapter's own caused draws from ordinary per-turn draws in a multi-turn trace, which the existing `countOf`/`maxAmount` helpers can't do safely without risking pool-wide overcounting; flagged in ENGINE_GAPS.md-adjacent notes / engine agent-memory, not silently worked around). Real trace evidence: this scenario's own two real `drawCard` lines. (8) LORE counter {event:'putCounter', counterType:'LORE', target:'self'}, oracle-anchored 'add a lore counter' — same real vocabulary/evidence shape (saga.ts's own real advanceSaga) summon-bahamut/jill's own migrations already establish. (9) sacrifice ACT {event:'sacrifice', target:'self'}, bare tag (no zone fields — 714.4's own sacrifice, same ACT-vs-CONSEQUENCE treatment summon-bahamut's own identical 'Sacrifice after N' fact gets), oracle-anchored 'Sacrifice after III'. (10) dies CONSEQUENCE {event:'dies', from:'Battlefield', to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self', target:'self'}, same anchor — real trace evidence (this scenario's own real 714.4 sacrifice fires and the card leaves the battlefield). Sink facts (2): chapter I/II's own target precondition {to:'Battlefield', controller:'opp', types:{has:['Creature']}} (mirrors Ice Flan's own sink) and chapter III's own 'wants tapped opponent creatures' want, same shape (mirrors summon-bahamut's own chapter IV 'wants permanents you control' sink) — deliberately two separate facts despite the coincidentally-identical constraint shape, since each anchors to a different real sentence, same 'a fact is tied to one real textual span, not deduplicated by shape' convention already established pool-wide (no precedent anywhere in the pool for one fact carrying multiple annotation entries — checked).

Checks run: verify-synergy.mjs scoped (0 hard failures; soft notes only: tapForMana x5, untap x6 (5 of your own Islands + the opponent's own natural Coeurl untap — real, unattributed background noise, not this card's own effect, same treatment Jill/Bahamut's own scenarios already get for land untaps), attack x1 (the opponent's own real attack, independent of this card, same 'unattributed opponent action' treatment diamond-weapon's own scenario already establishes)) and full pool (320 v2 cards checked, 3 skipped, 3 hard failures — black-mage-s-rod/stolen-uniform/the-water-crystal, pre-existing, unrelated, concurrent-session gaps, not caused by this task). npx vitest run functional-model: 351/351 passed (unchanged). The chapter I/II tap/stun facts and both sink facts produce 0 matches in the pool today (real, documented gaps — no other pool card sources a bare `event:'tap'`/`event:'putCounter':'stun'` producer yet, and no pool card's own self-enters fact currently satisfies this card's own two sinks either), not fabricated.
knownGaps: compute-weights.mjs's `sourceMagnitude` has no case for `event:'drawCard'` at all — falls through to the neutral-floor default (1), silently wrong for any drawCard fact with a real multi-card magnitude (this card's own chapter III value was hand-corrected to 4 after discovering this; Summon: Bahamut's own identical-shaped chapter III fact, already at value 4, would regress the same way if ever rerun through this script). A correct fix needs to distinguish a specific effect's own caused draws from ordinary per-turn draws inside a multi-turn engine-piloted trace, which the existing `countOf`/`maxAmount` helpers can't do safely without risking pool-wide overcounting on every other multi-turn scenario that also has natural draw-step draws in its own log — not attempted here, flagged for a dedicated pass.

Chapter I/II's own tap+stun facts and both sink facts (chapter I/II target precondition, chapter III's own tapped-opponent-creatures want) currently match nothing else in the pool — no other card sources a bare `event:'tap'`/`event:'putCounter':'stun'` producer, and no pool card's own self-enters fact currently satisfies either of this card's own sinks. Real, pre-existing pool-authoring gaps, not something this card's own migration could fix from its side.
